name: O-SHI-KA-KE Saiminjutsushi ~Toraware no In'yoku Marionette~
original_name: O・SHI・KA・KE 催眠術師 ～囚われの淫欲マリオネット～
source:
Touma Suzumura, an average looking college student, is hiding a secret that no one must know about.
Discovering his talent for hypnosis at a young age, he is now a college student capable of altering people's memories.

With powerful hypnotism in his disposal, Touma follows his inner desires and sneaks up on his targets.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
铃村当麻是一名相貌平平的大学生，却隐藏着一个无人知晓的秘密。
他在年轻时就发现了自己的催眠天赋，现在是一名能够改变人们记忆的大学生。

凭借强大的催眠术，当麻追随内心的欲望，悄悄接近目标。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095070/]Steam[/url]]
